_readme: 404, 500, the root error boundary and the maintenance notice.

notFound.metaDescription: The page you were looking for does not exist or has moved.
notFound.title: This page is not in the shop
notFound.description: The address you followed does not match anything on this site. It may have moved, or the link may be out of date.

error.title: Something went wrong at our end
error.description: This page failed to load. It is a fault on our side, not yours. Try again — and if it keeps happening, call or email us and we will sort it out.
error.contactNote: Need something urgently? Call {phone} or email {email}.

globalError.title: Something went wrong
globalError.description: The site failed to load. Please try again, or contact us directly at {phone}.

maintenance.title: We are working on the website
maintenance.description: The site is briefly offline while we make some updates. The workshop is open as usual — call or message us and we will help you straight away.
